full-sector write or locked RMW read
actual read return merges opaque bytes in RTL
actual write request acceptance keeps lock/credit
actual DRAM scheduler WR event binds sector/tag/column time
actual backing write becomes visible after scheduled CWL+burst and actual memory visibility
registered ACK held stable through finite CDC and consumer ready stalls
consumer ACK handshake returns completion credit and releases lock; only then publish fence
invariants: no ACK from request acceptance or free-running latency timer
tag/generation not reused until independent complete controller drain proof
all shared reads and writes consult sector lock
read/write/RMW share actual controller command and byte budgets
visible event must match scheduled transaction and cannot precede data burst end
CDC consumer handshake, not fast-side FIFO enqueue, returns ownership

price sector routing crossbar arbitration and finite landing queues for every consumer
price both CDC directions, completion return and clockphase schedule
compose Qwen KV/vector/TP and DeepSeek SIMD/RF/staging instruction calendars and waits
price throughput limit from only four writes/controller including RMW read/write and consumerACK retention
derive full-size legal SM/controller/L2 macro floorplan before PnR

reference.scope: model lifecycle reference, no implemented common controller

qualified_components.scope: checkpoint-payload macro transport and request metadata retention only; no generation publication proof

publication_contract.macro_unit_scope: rsp_epoch/rsp_id echo requested metadata only; macro unit stores no generation tags and proves no epoch publication
publication_contract.publish_prerequisite: Actual matching writecommit(row,epoch,producer_transaction_id) must be observed for every consumed row before a descriptor/fence publishes
publication_contract.reader_reservation: Service validates descriptor epoch, committed row range and producer identity before macro read; retain reader ownership until actual consumer completion handshake
publication_contract.reuse: Overwrite or new epoch descriptor is blocked while any reader owns the region; memory response acceptance does not release reader ownership
publication_contract.invalid_requests: Stale epoch, uncommitted row, mismatched producer ID and unknown descriptor fail closed; never relabel old data with a new echoed epoch
expected_negative_gates: stale requested epoch despite correct SRAM bytes
overwrite attempt while one of multiple readers outstanding
macro response accepted but consumer completion stalled
delayed old ACK after epoch retirement
publication before all producer rows committed
publication_contract.model_admission: Actual publication bitmap/descriptor capacity, reader counters, replay/epoch checks, arbitration and fences must be area/latency priced; no free host scoreboard
